description: Provides real-time information about BMTC buses operating at an interval of 10 seconds in Bengaluru City. It captures the vehicles current geographic position [latitude, longitude, and bearing(GPS Angle)], associated trip and route identifiers, stop reference, and operational status (e.g., in transit, stopped). This data supports live tracking of public transit buses and enables applications that monitor service performance, route coverage, and bus movement patterns in the city.
